COSTNET: the European Cooperation for Statistics of Network Data Science.

https://costnet.webhosting.rug.nl/

 

COSTNET is COST Action CA15109 which aims to foster an international European collaboration on the emerging field of statistics of network data science. COSTNET facilitates interaction and collaboration between diverse groups of statistical network modellers, establishing a large and vibrant interconnected and inclusive community of network scientists.

 

 

 

Programme
Day 1 - Fundamental network concepts:

  • Collection and organization of relational data, Visualisation, Network descriptives.
  • Guest lecture: Alessandro Provetti.

Day 2 - Statistical modelling:

  • Exponential random graph models (ERGMs), Model assessment, Model selection,
  • Application and tips on working with real-world datasets.
  • Guest lecture: Kerstin Sailer.

Day 3 - Advanced topics:

  • Bayesian inference for ERGMs, Latent space network models, Case studies.

 

 

 

Dear COSTNET colleagues,

 

As we have now received confirmation of our COSTNET budget this year, we can formally asks for PhD students that would like to learn about statistical models for the analysis of relational data with application to real-world problems in social sciences to consider the STATISTICAL SOCIAL NETWORK ANALYSIS WITH R course in LONDON from 21-23 June 2017. COSTNET will reduce the registration fee to 100 euro and at the same time provide 780 euro per student (so 680 euro can be used for travel and accommodation). 

 

Acceptance is on a first come first serve basis and only 9 places are available!

 

Please fill out the COSTNET registration form on:

 

             http://bida.bbk.ac.uk/SSNAR17

 

and send this form to Isabella Gollini <i.go...@bbk.ac.uk>, the organizer of the workshop.
